mapper.sql: run_id, template_id, rule_id, rule_version_id, validation_type, run_status, total_count, error_count, warning_count, started_by_user_id, started_by_name, started_time, finished_time, scope_snapshot, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select issue_id, run_id, template_id, rule_id, rule_version_id, severity, issue_code, scope_type, scope_id, scope_name, business_subtype, node_code, node_name, issue_message, suggestion, issue_snapshot, create_by, create_time, remark from approval_validation_issue where run_id = #{runId} order by case severity when 'ERROR' then 0 else 1 end, issue_id
mapper.insert: insert into approval_validation_run ( template_id, rule_id, rule_version_id, validation_type, run_status, total_count, error_count, warning_count, started_by_user_id, started_by_name, started_time, scope_snapshot, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{templateId}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{validationType}, #{runStatus}, coalesce(#{totalCount}, 0), coalesce(#{errorCount}, 0), coalesce(#{warningCount}, 0), #{startedByUserId}, #{startedByName}, coalesce(#{startedTime}, sysdate()), #{scopeSnapshot}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update approval_validation_run set run_status = #{run.runStatus}, total_count = #{run.totalCount}, error_count = #{run.errorCount}, warning_count = #{run.warningCount}, finished_time = #{run.finishedTime}, update_by = #{run.updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{run.remark} where run_id = #{run.runId} and run_status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: insert into approval_validation_issue ( run_id, template_id, rule_id, rule_version_id, severity, issue_code, scope_type, scope_id, scope_name, business_subtype, node_code, node_name, issue_message, suggestion, issue_snapshot, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{runId}, #{templateId}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{severity}, #{issueCode}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{scopeName}, #{businessSubtype}, #{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{issueMessage}, #{suggestion}, #{issueSnapshot}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
